artBrief: **Retro adventure.** Two paths—one marked by a book, the other by speech-bubble shapes—meet at a bright gateway. One small traveler proceeds through it. No text embedded in the symbols.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Retro adventure. Two paths—one marked by a book, the other by speech-bubble shapes—meet at a bright gateway. One small traveler proceeds through it. No text embedded in the symbols. A white fox traveler where two broad paths meet at one bright gateway. One path has a large open-book symbol, the other a single blank speech-bubble sign. Warm adventure greens and gold, clear simple convergence.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
